questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(2, 30, 15)

(21, 189, 9)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(a, b, c) → b = a × c

(2, 30, 15) → 2 × 15 = 30

(21, 189, 9) → 21 × 9 = 189

Let's check each option:

 
• 
 
(45, 543, 12) → 45 × 12 = 540 ≠ 543

 
 
• 
 
(46, 969, 21) → 46 × 21 = 966 ≠ 969

 
 
• 
 
(4, 40, 10) → 4 × 10 = 40 

 
 
• 
 
(13, 263, 20) → 13 × 20 = 260 ≠ 263

 

Thus, (4, 40, 10) is the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the given sets.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
A group of numbers/symbols is coded using letter codes as per the codes given below and the conditions that follow. Note: If none of the conditions apply, then the codes for the respective number/symbol are to be followed directly as given in the table.

Conditions:

(i) If the first element is a symbol and the last element a number, the codes for these two (the first and last elements) are to be interchanged.

(ii) If both the second and third elements are multiples of 2, the third element is to be coded as the code for the second element.

(iii) If the second element is an odd number and the last element a symbol, the second and last elements are to be coded as *.

What will be the code for the following group?

& 4 8 $ #
questions.solution:
**Given group: **& 4 8 $ #

**Code table:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84ba0d58ce97e24db33292aa09c781bb0d1e2abe4828bc8df54783549416b6e8.png] 

Base codes for & 4 8 $ # → C Y P R A

Checking conditions:

(i) If first element is a symbol and last element is a number → codes interchanged.

 
• First element = &(symbol), Last element = #(symbol) → last is NOT a number 

(ii) If both second and third elements are multiples of 2 → third element coded as second element's code.

 
• Second element = 4(multiple of 2), Third element = 8(multiple of 2) → condition applies
 
• Third element (8) takes code of second element (4) → code of 4 = Y
 
• So third element coded as Y

(iii) If second element is odd and last element is a symbol → second and last coded as *.

 
• Second element = 4(even) 

Applying condition (ii):

questions.question: In a row of 39 people facing north, Sangeeta is 14th from the left end. If Meghana sits 11th to the right of Sangeeta, then what is Meghana’s position from the right end of the row?
questions.solution:
**Given: **In a row of 39 people facing north, Sangeeta is 14th from the left end. If Meghana sits 11th to the right of Sangeeta.

Total people = 39

Sangeeta is 14th from left, Meghana is 11th to the right of Sangeeta

It means:

Meghana’s position from left = 14 + 11 = 25

Meghana's position from right = 39 - 25 + 1

= 40 - 25

= 15

Thus, Meghana’s position from the right end of the row is 15.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

All samosas are buns.

(I): Some cakes are buns.

questions.question: Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, turns left and drives 20 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 28 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
questions.solution:
**Given:** Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, turns left and drives 20 km. He then takes a left tur
n and drives 28 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P.

questions.question: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits third to the left of C. Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P. Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E. A is an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits to the immediate left and right of Q, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. F sits third to the left of C.

2. Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P.

3. Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E.

4. A is an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3189c7eb9bc9fc4c69efa486182926c55737273683c110def1a0924f9e3b8e69.png] 

Q, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfe3c440b4f6abacb064ef9bbffd7b5e1be9969f9f6f8b621ee098b157e8c58f.png] 

Thus, C and P sits to the immediate left and right of Q, respectively.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
